referenceFunction.generalComment: The measures of the visible door sheet are 0.9m x 2.0m. The bill of materials is based on data from 3 aluminium system houses. A weighted average was calculated with the estimated market shares of these companies. Data on production losses, work materials, packaging materials, energy demand and transports were provided by 1 producer of aluminium doors. Production losses were only available for aluminium profiles, aluminium sheets and glazing.; UUID: 9b0eb861-40a8-389c-99aa-ce5dc1fcfd1a
